name: document-platform
description: AppToolkitLab by Gonexel — document tools, SaaS workflows, and software marketplace

scripts.build: corepack pnpm db:generate && corepack pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.clean: corepack pnpm -r --if-present run clean && rm -rf node_modules
scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d --wait postgres redis minio gotenberg
scripts.infra:down: docker compose stop postgres redis minio gotenberg
scripts.node:setup: corepack pnpm --filter './packages/**' --if-present run build && corepack pnpm db:generate && corepack pnpm db:push && corepack pnpm db:seed
scripts.hybrid:setup: docker compose stop api worker web && corepack pnpm infra:up && corepack pnpm node:setup
scripts.hybrid:dev: docker compose stop api worker web && corepack pnpm infra:up && corepack pnpm node:setup && corepack pnpm node:dev
scripts.db:migrate: corepack pnpm --filter @docconv/api exec prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:push: corepack pnpm --filter @docconv/api exec prisma db push
scripts.db:seed: corepack pnpm --filter @docconv/api exec prisma db seed
